back_translation: The word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, prophesy and say, the Lord GOD says this: Wail, ‘Alas for that day!’
For the day is near; the Day of the LORD is near, a day of clouds, a time of judgment for the nations.
A sword will come against Egypt, and anguish will be in Cush when the slain fall in Egypt; her wealth will be taken away, and her foundations torn down.
Cush, Put, and Lud, all the mixed peoples, Kub, and the men of the covenant land will fall with Egypt by the sword.
The LORD says this: Those who support Egypt will fall, and her proud strength will collapse; from Migdol to Syene they will fall by the sword within her, declares the Lord GOD.
They will be desolate among desolate lands, and her cities will be among ruined cities.
Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I set fire to Egypt and all her helpers are shattered.
On that day messengers will go out from Me in ships to terrify complacent Cush, and anguish will come upon them on the day of Egypt's doom. For behold, it is coming.
The Lord GOD says this: I will put an end to the hordes of Egypt by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
He and his army with him, the most ruthless of nations, will be brought in to destroy the land; they will draw their swords against Egypt and fill the land with the slain.
I will make the streams dry up and sell the land into the hand of the wicked; I will desolate the land and all that fills it by the hand of foreigners. I, the LORD, have spoken.
The Lord GOD says this: I will destroy the idols and put an end to the images in Noph. There will no longer be a prince in the land of Egypt, and I will put fear in the land of Egypt.
I will lay Pathros waste, set fire to Zoan, and execute judgments on No.
I will pour out My wrath on Sin, the stronghold of Egypt, and cut off the hordes of No.
I will set fire to Egypt; Sin will writhe in anguish, No will be breached, and Noph will face daily distress.
The young men of Aven and Pi-beseth will fall by the sword, and those cities will go into captivity.
At Tahpanhes the day will be dark when I break the yoke of Egypt there, and her proud strength will come to an end. A cloud will cover her, and her daughter-towns will go into captivity.
So I will execute judgments on Egypt, and they will know that I am the LORD.”
On the seventh day of the first month, in the eleventh year, the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
“Son of man, I have broken the arm of Pharaoh king of Egypt; and behold, it has not been bound up to heal it, nor splinted to make it strong enough to hold the sword.
Therefore the Lord GOD says this: Behold, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt. I will break his arms, both the strong one and the one already broken, and make the sword fall from his hand.
I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands.
I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword in his hand, but I will break the arms of Pharaoh, and he will groan before the king of Babylon like a mortally wounded man.

I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon, but the arms of Pharaoh will fall limp. Then they will know that I am the LORD, when I put My sword in the hand of the king of Babylon, and he wields it against the land of Egypt.
I will scatter the Egyptians among the nations and disperse them throughout the lands. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
